verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law and tax firm. It says it uses legal tech, AI-based systems and a software-supported transparency-register unit, so a client-facing AI assistant is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence shows a built-in AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The AI mention describes how the firm delivers its own advice, not a product feature clients use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: The firm combines legal and tax expertise with legal tech, digital workflows and AI-based systems to provide efficient and scalable advice.
